metadata.title: Research
metadata.description: Microrobotics and biomedical micromanipulation: optical and magnetic actuation, physics-informed perception, digital twins and human–robot shared control.

data.title: Optical Micromanipulation
data.description: We use optical tweezers to manipulate microscopic objects and fabricated microrobots. Our work combines optical-force modelling, microscopy-based perception and human–robot interaction to study controlled manipulation at small scales.
project: Platforms: Multi-spot optical tweezers, fabricated microrobots and interactive simulation.
Perception: Pose and depth estimation from microscopy, including physics-informed learning and sim-to-real data generation.
Control: Learning-based manipulation, digital-twin modelling and virtual visuo-haptic teleoperation.
Application focus: Precise handling of microscopic objects for biomedical research.
Recent work: ICRA 2026 sim-to-real perception; Du-FreqNet preprint; virtual visuo-haptic teleoperation preprint.

data.title: Magnetic Micromanipulation
data.description: We investigate how external magnetic fields can actuate and steer miniature robots. Our research connects actuation design, coordinated manipulation and adaptive shared control for navigation and interaction in constrained environments.
project: Platforms: Electromagnetic coils, permanent magnets and robot-assisted magnetic actuation.
Embodiment: Magnetic functionalisation, robot fabrication and reconfigurable actuation systems.
Control: Bimanual coordination, haptic guidance and learning from visual and language instructions.
Application focus: Microscale transport and biomedical manipulation research.
Recent work: magnetic microrobot fabrication; DexterousMag preprint; Mag-VLA preprint.

data.title: Robot-Assisted Microsurgery and Micromanipulation
data.description: We develop perception and control methods for precise manipulation with externally actuated tools, including micromanipulators and microsurgical robots. We study how visual feedback, motion scaling and shared autonomy can support reliable operation.
project: Platforms: Precision micromanipulators, piezoelectric positioning stages and robot-assisted microsurgery systems.
Perception: Multi-pipette localisation and image-based state estimation for patch-clamp workflows.
Interaction: Digital-twin teleoperation, adaptive motion scaling and human–robot shared control.
Application focus: Patch-clamp research, microsurgical training and delicate biological manipulation.
Recent work: multi-pipette localisation (IROS 2025); micro-dexterity review preprint.
